'''Shinban Four-Eyes''' is an ogre found in [[Brol'ok Mound]] in [[Gilneas]]. He is vying for power amongst the [[Brol'ok]], with his chief rival being [[Chief Maulfist]]. Although he calls himself Four-Eyes, he only has three - he claims that the fourth is a hidden one that gives him the vision required to lead the Brol'ok.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|45|The Staff of Shinban}}</ref>

==Objective of==
* Drops [[Staff of Shinban]] for {{questlong|Alliance|45|The Staff of Shinban}}.
